title: Nimbus authority lease
description: Wire contract for the authority lease the cloud issues to exactly one edge cluster. The required field set is fixed by Nimbus PRD v5.0 Sec. 6 and the Person 4 scope: {lease_id, version, priority, deadline_ts, expiry_ts, allowed_zones, forbidden_zones, speed_limit, assigned_robots, task_sequence, cluster_id, when_to_escalate}. task_sequence items are robot sub-tasks (see robot_subtask.schema.json). Only the highest version is ever honoured (FR-8). The cross-field rule deadline_ts <= expiry_ts is enforced in the validation module, not here.

lease_id.description: Unique identifier of this lease instance.

version.description: Monotonic lease version; a new version from the cloud replaces the old one outright (FR-5, FR-8).

priority.description: Urgency class; urgent work goes first (FR-14).

deadline_ts.description: Time by which the task should complete (SC-1 uses 12 minutes).

expiry_ts.description: Time after which the cluster finishes the current step and parks its robots; no new work may start past it.

allowed_zones.description: Zones the robots may enter; nothing outside them may be attempted (FR-5).

forbidden_zones.description: Zones the robots must never enter, even if reachable.

speed_limit.description: Maximum robot speed in m/s while the lease is held.

task_sequence.description: Ordered robot sub-tasks the edge splits and monitors (FR-3).

cluster_id.description: The single edge cluster holding this lease (SC-1: the East-wing cluster).

when_to_escalate.description: Named conditions under which the edge must ask the cloud instead of deciding alone (FR-4).
